panels.title: The Battered Door
panels.scene_description: Mira stands in a cluttered seaside workshop, a glowing, erratic musical box in her hands. Rain pours through a splintered window, and a massive stormy wave churns outside.
panels.narration: The storm had come for the secret.
panels.caption: A rhythm out of tune.
panels.image_prompt: Watercolor storybook style, mid-shot of a young inventor named Mira with a stormy expression, standing in a cluttered seaside workshop. She holds a glowing, erratic musical box. Rain pours through a splintered window, and a massive stormy wave churns outside. Moody lighting, dramatic composition, no text or lettering.

panels.title: The Rhythm Breaks
panels.scene_description: The musical box's light flickers red. Wind whips through the workshop, knocking over books and blueprints. Mira frantically adjusts the gears, her face showing determination and panic.
panels.narration: The gears were spinning too fast.
panels.caption: The storm demands precision.
panels.image_prompt: Watercolor storybook style, close-up of Mira's determined and panicked face as she frantically adjusts the gears of a red-glowing musical box. Wind whips through the workshop, knocking over scattered books and blueprints. Dynamic action, intense lighting, no text or lettering.

panels.title: Dancing with the Storm
panels.scene_description: Mira steps onto the rain-slicked balcony, holding the box. She taps out a rhythm on her knee, her hair whipping wildly in the wind, her expression focused and intense.
panels.narration: She matched the chaos with her own beat.
panels.caption: Finding her footing.
panels.image_prompt: Watercolor storybook style, wide shot of Mira standing on a rain-slicked balcony, holding the musical box and tapping a rhythm on her knee. Her hair whips wildly in the wind, her expression focused and intense. The storm swirls around her. Dramatic backdrop, no text or lettering.

panels.title: The Storm's Crescendo
panels.scene_description: The box glows brilliant gold. The storm's waves crest and curl, mirroring the box's rhythm. Mira, smiling, steps into the surf, her boots splashing in the churning water.
panels.caption: Perfect harmony.
panels.image_prompt: Watercolor storybook style, dynamic action shot of Mira smiling as she steps into the churning surf, holding a brilliant gold-glowing musical box. Waves crest and curl in rhythm with the box. Splashing water, vibrant colors, epic composition, no text or lettering.

panels.title: The Calm After
panels.scene_description: The storm has cleared, and the sun breaks through. The sea is calm. Mira, soaking wet but triumphant, sits in the doorway of the intact workshop, the box glowing softly and steadily. She looks at the peaceful horizon.
panels.narration: The silence was music of its own.
panels.caption: Tamed and whole.
panels.image_prompt: Watercolor storybook style, serene wide shot of a calm sea at sunrise. Mira, soaking wet but smiling triumphantly, sits in the doorway of a messy but intact seaside workshop. The musical box in her lap glows with a soft, steady light. Peaceful horizon, warm lighting, no text or lettering.
